decisions.target: small business owners with a Cobalt card reader

actions.action: Instant dispute credit up to $100 per customer, 8 weeks
Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge we credit up to $100 right away. We are adding a $10 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 9 (small business owners with a Cobalt card reader).
Actions: Instant dispute credit up to $100 per customer, 8 weeks, Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $2,100,000 of the $4M budget.

actions.action: Free replacement card on request and payment alerts

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. You can order a free new card at any time, and we now send an alert for every card payment. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 5 (paycheck customers).
Actions: Free replacement card on request and payment alerts, Offline card limit during migration $100 -> $250.
Cost $400,000 of the $4M budget.
